statement: Four spheres in real three-space can have twelve distinct real common affine tangent lines; twelve is the maximum.
scope: Ordinary spheres with positive radii and a finite regular common-tangent fibre.
notes: The 12-real unit-sphere construction is already in Macdonald–Pach–Theobald, Theorem 1 and Section 3, explicitly cited by Sottile–Theobald. The latter supplies the general-dimensional upper bound and construction.
